issues: 13 张 × 12 帧超出 144 帧，末两张在最后一帧仍在入场途中，结尾没有落定
堆是匀速线性漂移，背景 grid 也匀速走，读作传送带而不是“一张压一张”
飞入的卡正文要等落定那一帧才硬切出现，近一半帧里最上一张是空卡
摘要是四根灰色骨架条，作者行是 A. Author, B. Writer 占位
下方糊卡叠成一大块浓黑重影，纯色 #FAFAFA 底没有层次
changes: 改为 11 张、间隔 14→9.5 帧递减的发牌节拍（均值仍≈12f），末张 f≈123.5 落定，留约 20f 静止
每落一张把整叠往右下推一格（6f ease-out），grid 位移由同一累计量导出，一推一停严格同步
正文在飞行后半程淡入上浮、被下一张盖住时淡出；入场 1.5f 即不透明，飞行段按速度加纵向运动模糊；落位压缩改 2.4f 正弦包络
卡面出版级：分类 chip、作者、两行真实感摘要、arXiv 编号/引用数/页数与 PDF 标签；发丝线 + 内高光 + 顶部受光
深卡额外降透明度、阴影随深度减弱；亮场柔光底 + 上下羽化的 grid + 暗角 + 颗粒，DesignStage 改 zoom 栅格化
issuesEn: 13 cards × 12 frames overran 144 frames, so the last two were still flying in on the final frame; no settle
The pile drifted linearly and the background grid scrolled at constant speed, reading as a conveyor belt rather than one card pressing another
An incoming card's body hard-cut in only on its landing frame, so the top card was blank in nearly half the frames
The abstract was four grey skeleton bars and the author line was A. Author, B. Writer placeholder
The blurred cards below piled into a heavy black smear on a flat #FAFAFA background
changesEn: Now 11 cards on an accelerating deal rhythm (intervals 14→9.5f, still ≈12f on average); the last lands at f≈123.5 leaving ~20f of stillness
Each landing pushes the whole pile one step down-right (6f ease-out); the grid offset derives from the same accumulator, so they step and stop together

The body fades and lifts in during the second half of the flight and fades out as the next card covers it; cards are opaque within 1.5f, get velocity-based vertical motion blur in flight, and the landing squash is a 2.4f sine pulse
Publication-grade card faces: category chip, authors, a two-line realistic abstract, arXiv id / citations / pages and a PDF tag; hairline, inner highlight and top light
Deeper cards also lose opacity and their shadows weaken with depth; light soft-lit backdrop, a feathered grid, vignette and grain; DesignStage switched to zoom rasterization
